creativeThesis: Turn an everyday thermal contradiction into a physical understanding of contact: a hotter surface can build a barrier that changes the heat path.
viewerExperience: See two droplets behave differently, move into a large luminous vapor-gap section, follow heat across that gap, then return to the paired mechanism with the scope understood.
emotionalTarget: Immediate prediction error, then satisfying causal comprehension.
visualThesis: Original material macro: brushed steel, clear blue-white water and warm heat paths. One continuous usable visual field grows from paired contact/no-contact behavior into an enlarged interface. No scientific footage claim or plotted lifetime values.

decisions.treatment: Original deterministic SVG/CSS material macro and enlarged interface, paired droplets, qualitative heat-path animation.
decisions.rationale: The crucial vapor layer is invisible at ordinary scale; controlled magnification makes the cause legible without faking a recorded experiment.

decisions.treatment: Neutral graphite steel, luminous water, warm amber heat paths; broad horizontal metal planes with reflective grain, no repeated headline cards.
decisions.rationale: Material identity and heat-path contrast explain contact. This is a chosen physical scene, not a science palette.

decisions.treatment: Local Kokoro af_heart at 0.97, complete semantic sentences per generation unit; clear question and calm scoped explanation.
decisions.rationale: Current narrator policy. Owner prosody feedback requires grammatical continuity; visual caption chunks must not define audio breaks.

decisions.treatment: Large off-white Manrope 48px, full short semantic sentences across two or three natural lines; stable left alignment in a clear lower field, four-frame fades.
decisions.rationale: Preserve complete contrast and qualifiers; measured sentence duration sets timing, not typography-driven TTS fragments.

decisions.treatment: Narration alone; no music, hiss, boiling recording or continuous ambience.
decisions.rationale: The contrast is visual and analytical. A fabricated hiss could imply a real experiment or mask the physical explanation; silence keeps speech legible.

decisions.treatment: Story-led measured speech with short sentence pauses; reveal gap before naming it, hold paired payoff briefly.
decisions.rationale: The barrier needs time to be understood; no runtime threshold padding.

decisions.treatment: Paired metal scenes immediately show rapid contact evaporation and a persistent vapor-supported bead while the conditional question is spoken.
decisions.rationale: Cold premise works in plain words. Qualitative asynchronous depiction is disclosed; no stopwatch or measured speed.

decisions.treatment: Four bound provisional playback profiles, critical scene/labels/captions/disclosure sampled within common surviving insets.
decisions.rationale: Composition is platform aware; native geometry/crops and exact-media device QA remain unknown, not an implied safety pass.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Latest four exact approved masters; actual canonical sheets inspected again, available directions read. No popularity or domain filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: A material interface filling usable width, split comparison grows into a magnified vapor-gap section; fewer headings and no explanatory card grid. Auditory/readability continuity deliberate.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: A familiar centered object on dark stage would be convenient and may resemble Chladni. Internally considered observational footage and abstract heat-path typography before choosing an original interface because the hidden gap is the explanatory center.

alternatives.storyTradeoffs: Strong observable contrast; rights and exact acquisition/setup not established, and ordinary footage cannot show the hidden vapor gap without a cutaway. Remains valid with genuine evidence and licensed footage.

alternatives.treatment: Bright abstract thermal-path typography with two contact diagrams and no material water rendering.
materialChanges: No pan/steel object or reflective bead.

alternatives.storyTradeoffs: Very clear distinction but risks reducing an immediately physical question to a lecture; material comparison gives intuitive expectation and interface magnification explains the cause.

convenienceResponse.resolution: Choose original material interface with paired behavior and enlarged gap, avoiding repeated small-object headings.
convenienceResponse.chosenForStory: The viewer must see loss of contact and a new heat path. Interface magnification makes the mechanism explicit without suggesting measured footage; the choice is independently justified, not an SVG availability preference.
